name: voice-agent-config-generator
description: Build and test CloudTalk AI voice agents: generate, fix, and validate Voice Agent v2 (Expert Mode) JSON configurations, and simulate caller conversations against them — for customers and partners creating inbound/outbound agents. Works fully offline, and can read and operate your CloudTalk account (numbers, knowledge bases, tools, agents) through the CloudTalk MCP when connected.

api_key.title: CloudTalk API key (base64)
api_key.description: Optional — leave empty to use the plugin offline. Paste the base64 of API_KEY_ID:API_KEY_SECRET from Dashboard > Account > Settings > API keys; build it with: echo -n "API_KEY_ID:API_KEY_SECRET" | base64
